description: Strassen: Schweizerischen Hauptstrassen (DGSV - MinVV) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. Die Signalisationsbehörde kann mit Zustimmung des Bundesamtes in grösseren Ortschaften zusätzliche Hauptstrassen bestimmen oder aufheben. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
